howToPlay: Use your jumps to leap over walls and avoid enemy fire while closing the distance. Time your Super to become invincible and reposition safely. Utilize your gadgets and star powers to control enemies or burst down non-brawler targets.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased pressure, SHIELD for extra survivability, or GADGET COOLDOWN to use your special abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits a highly aggressive player who excels at hit-and-run tactics and precise timing.
